overlapping_phenotypes: Progressive lower extremity spasticity, hyperreflexia, extensor plantar responses, gait imbalance
discriminating_logic: SPG7/SPG11 frequently exhibit cervical spinal cord atrophy, thin corpus callosum (in SPG11), or severe peripheral neuropathy, whereas SCA52 exhibits isolated cerebellar vermian atrophy without severe spinal cord volume loss.

overlapping_phenotypes: Slowly progressive gait ataxia, hyperreflexia, lower limb spasticity
discriminating_phenotype: absence of progressive ptosis or ophthalmoparesis
discriminating_logic: Absence of progressive ptosis or ophthalmoparesis; distinctive switch II RAB3A recurrent missense genotype.

overlapping_phenotypes: Late-onset, slowly progressive cerebellar ataxia, nystagmus, dysarthria
discriminating_phenotype: presence of mild pyramidal spasticity and tremor
discriminating_logic: Presence of mild pyramidal spasticity and tremor in SCA52 distinguishes it from pure cerebellar syndromes.

overlapping_phenotypes: Early neurodevelopmental delays, non-progressive or very indolent congenital ataxia
discriminating_logic: SCA52 is predominantly an adult-onset progressive neurodegenerative disorder rather than an obligate infantile non-progressive ataxic encephalopathy.
